description: This file defines the 'theme' class and its nested classes for managing UI themes in the Wesnoth game, including objects like labels, panels, menus, and status items, with methods for configuration and layout.
external_methods: const SDL_Rect& theme::main_map_location(const SDL_Rect& screen) const
const SDL_Rect& theme::mini_map_location(const SDL_Rect& screen) const

classes.name: theme
classes.description: Main class managing UI themes, including panels, labels, menus, and status items, with configuration and layout methods.

classes.name: theme::object
classes.description: Base class representing a UI object with location and anchoring properties.

classes.name: theme::label
classes.description: Represents a text label with optional icon and font size.

classes.name: theme::status_item
classes.description: Represents a status display item with prefix, postfix, and optional label.

classes.name: theme::panel
classes.description: Represents a UI panel with an associated image.

classes.name: theme::menu
classes.description: Represents a menu with title, items, and context flag.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Constructor initializing theme with configuration and screen size.

methods.name: set_resolution
methods.description: Adjusts theme layout based on new screen resolution.

methods.name: get_status_item
methods.description: Retrieves a status item by name.

methods.name: main_map_location
methods.description: Returns the location of the main map.

methods.name: mini_map_location
methods.description: Returns the location of the mini map.

methods.name: get_known_themes
methods.description: Returns a list of known theme names.
